name: Infrastructure Failures
description: Tests failed due to network, broker, or cloud infrastructure issues

name: Producer Timeout
description: Producer failed to send messages within delivery.timeout.ms
messageRegex: .*(Expiring.*record.*has passed since batch creation|delivery.*timeout|Failed to send message sync).*

name: Topic Creation Failures
description: Failed to create or delete Kafka topics
messageRegex: .*(Failed to create topic|Failed to delete topic|createTopics.*timed out).*

name: Consumer Rebalance Issues
description: Consumer group coordination and rebalancing failures

name: Assertion Failures
description: Test assertions did not meet expected conditions

name: Performance Threshold Violations
description: Performance tests exceeded expected time or throughput limits

name: SSL/TLS Configuration Issues
description: SSL certificate or keystore configuration errors

name: Offset Management Failures
description: Issues with offset commit, reset, or position tracking

name: Flaky Tests
description: Tests that passed on retry or show intermittent failures

name: Product Defects
description: Legitimate bugs in the application under test

name: Test Infrastructure
description: Issues with test framework, BaseTest, or test utilities
